reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.quote: The reproducible object is a frozen, patient-level pre-to-post score built only from assay blocks whose treatment contrast is separable from batch, internally stable under patient resampling, and tested once on the locked second cohort. Integration constructs that score across incomplete modalities; enrichment interprets or optionally regularizes it; external validation is the only confirmation. Do not call a pathway hit, a joint factor model, or a development-set p-value a reproducible treatment program.
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: Use frozen quantification pipelines.
checks.reason: No executable modality-specific normalization/quantification algorithm or explicit candidate set and calibration-to-choice procedure. Technical criteria are useful but do not specify the transformations to run.

checks.quote: Standardize scores using discovery-fold means and SDs.
checks.reason: The preceding scores are built from paired deltas. Centering those deltas by the discovery mean changes the target to deviation from the discovery response, whereas the external zero test is described as a pre/post change. Preserve the raw paired mean or define a separate sample-level transform; observed-modality averages also require explicit estimand comparability.
